Body frame: z (vertical) is the spin axis. Volume normalised to 1. Shapes are shown rotated about the spin axis so the longest equatorial axis lies along x (convex runs: each shape separately, since the rotational phase is a gauge freedom; hybrid runs: one common rotation, because all draws share the gauge-fixed body frame). Physical orientations (phase 0 at tref) are in the OBJ files.
